_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 06: 2024-11-04 to 2024-11-20. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He saw four oak trees and thought it meant four years, then warns against assuming or speculating about what the Spirit shows, since the interpretation can take months to come.
mentions.quote: I saw four oak trees and I thought it meant four years
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as put: he supplies a reading and withdraws it in the same breath.

mentions.claim_text: Asked about the crash he says he did see one, that he has no idea whether any of it can be averted, and that when he prays over it now he sees a covering and things look different than earlier in the year.
mentions.quote: you saw a crash I did can some of that be averted
mentions.condition_text: he raises averting by prayer but declines to say whether it applies
mentions.falsify_match: A market crash on the scale he described.
mentions.falsify_miss: No crash, which the covering language would absorb.

mentions.claim_text: Opening announcement of a February conference with Billy Brim and Rick Renner on end times eschatology.
mentions.quote: remember about the conference with Billy Brim. It's coming in in February
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: event announcement, no claim.

mentions.claim_text: He commends the two teachers as straight word of God rather than flakiness, and says November, December and January give viewers time to pray about attending.
mentions.quote: Not flakiness, just straight up word of God
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: event promotion.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that angels lead investigators and officials to check the right car or place without knowing why, so calamity or plots forming against the nation are found in time.
mentions.quote: your angels would lead them and they may not even know it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a thwarted plot and no plot look identical from outside.

mentions.claim_text: He reports emails from viewers who conceived in the same time frame, possibly the same day they prayed, and says God is growing families in the kingdom.
mentions.quote: they conceived all in the same time frame
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: self-reported anecdotes from an unnamed audience with no denominator.

mentions.claim_text: God is going to use this channel in a very unusual way, with demonstrations and manifestations of glory for salvation, deliverance and healing.
mentions.quote: to use this channel in an unusual way a very unusual way
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion for unusual use of a channel.

mentions.claim_text: He recommends a preacher whose meeting changed his life when prayed for, and says the same presence will do it for viewers.
mentions.quote: he prayed for me my life will never be the same
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: testimony and recommendation.

mentions.claim_text: He tells viewers to diary the February meeting at Glorious Church Fellowship and praises the teacher's grasp of the word.
mentions.quote: you can put it on your calendar that it's going to be in February
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: event announcement.

mentions.claim_text: He puts the meeting in the first week of February and encourages viewers to support it.
mentions.quote: I believe it's first first week of February
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: event announcement.

mentions.claim_text: Encouragement that a due season is coming for those in hard marriages or circumstances, and to keep fighting the fight of faith.
mentions.quote: in due season's coming in season's coming you have to keep
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no date and the outcome is private.

mentions.claim_text: He says Isaacs are coming, not only babies but blessings, increase, new jobs, multiplication and promotions in every area.
mentions.quote: there's Isaac's coming not just in babies but in in every area
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private outcomes over an unnamed audience.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that the steps of the righteous are ordered by the Lord and that no mistake is too big to overcome.
mentions.quote: the steps of the righteous order of the Lord
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He says the best is yet to come and there is no doom and gloom for the body of Christ regardless, though there will seem to be doom and gloom in the world.
mentions.quote: there's no Doom and Gloom for the body of Christ regardless we win
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the split between church and world outcomes means no state of the world tests it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he just saw something concerning the Thanksgiving Day Parade and prays a hedge over the people attending that there be no terrorist attack, taking authority over the demonic.
mentions.quote: I just saw that concerning the Thanksgiving Day Parade
mentions.condition_text: prayed down in the same breath as it is reported
mentions.falsify_match: An attack at the 2024 Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.
mentions.falsify_miss: The parade passes without incident, credited to prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He and his wife sow a thanksgiving offering believing for a blessed and financially blessed 2025, describing it as something they redo each year with a sacrificial seed of varying size.
mentions.quote: we sew into 2025 believing for a financial blessing all over 2025
mentions.condition_text: the blessing is tied to the sowing of a sacrificial seed
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private financial outcome tied to a giving condition.

mentions.claim_text: He gives an offering of thanksgiving and declares 2025 an amazing year, exceedingly abundantly above all that can be asked or thought.
mentions.quote: thank you Father that 2025 will be an amazing year
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the seed as his stamp in the spirit realm marking a blessed 2025 for him and his wife, with supernatural favour wherever his foot goes.
mentions.quote: it's like my my stamp in the spirit realm
mentions.condition_text: the outcome is tied to having sown the seed
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private outcome, giving condition.

mentions.claim_text: He urges believing God for big things, saying they did it for 2024 and are seeing fruit of things that were impossible in the natural.
mentions.quote: for 2024 and there's things that I know that in the natural were impossible
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: unspecified personal outcomes.

mentions.claim_text: A word of knowledge about swollen feet and ankles, possibly not pregnancy, with swelling and gout commanded to go and healing called over the body.
mentions.quote: I just saw swollen feet
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable in practice: a symptom common enough that someone in any large audience matches it.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for the glory cloud to rest on viewers with healings and demonstrations never seen before, including arms, legs, eyes and ears restored.
mentions.quote: people having arms and legs and eyes and ears
mentions.falsify_match: Verified restoration of a missing limb, which would be unambiguous.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such case is ever documented.

mentions.claim_text: He announces Billy Burke coming to Tulsa on 8 and 9 December, flagged as a meeting where he believes the glory will show up.
mentions.quote: Billy Burke is coming to Tulsa Oklahoma uh December the 8th and the 9th
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: event announcement.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the two teachers have never taught end time eschatology together before and will do a week long meeting in February.
mentions.quote: they've never done a meeting together teaching on end time stuff together ever
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: event announcement.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching on refusing a bad medical report, including being told you have two weeks to live, and holding bulldog faith rather than being moved by what you see or feel.
mentions.quote: you got two weeks to live buddy but you got to have that Bulldog Faith
mentions.condition_text: the outcome is tied to holding faith against the report
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a death is attributable to insufficient faith.

mentions.claim_text: A word of knowledge over women's bodies and over men's prostates and testosterone levels, with the fire of the Spirit said to be moving on the viewer right now.
mentions.quote: I believe the fire is coming on you right now I see it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: broad conditions across a large unnamed audience.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching from David on God's thoughts toward us, compared with how we think of people we love throughout the day.
mentions.quote: God told David about his thoughts towards us
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: devotional teaching.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer not to be the same a year from now but to go from glory to glory rather than camping and calling it satisfied.
mentions.quote: I don't want to be this same today this time next year
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: interior spiritual growth.

mentions.claim_text: He states a goal of a million person prayer army on YouTube by 2025, praying daily for the nations, taking communion and praying over what the Lord gives them.
mentions.quote: million prayer Army on this YouTube platform bringing forth a million people
mentions.falsify_match: A million people praying daily with the channel, measurable against subscriber and view counts.
mentions.falsify_miss: The audience stays far short of a million daily.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that there be no virus and no plague at all, that there will not be a major virus again in 2025, 2026, 2027 or 2028, and that the plan to take down the dollar is averted.
mentions.quote: a major virus again in 2024 going into I mean I 2025 2026 2027
mentions.condition_text: declared as a prayer of prevention over the same years his plague claims cover
mentions.falsify_match: No major virus and no dollar collapse through 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: Either occurs, which would falsify this prayer while confirming his plague and dollar claims.

mentions.claim_text: He says he keeps praying into what the extension means: more time to do what, and what will be done with the next four years into the 2028 cycle, asking whether people will get lazy in the blessing.
mentions.quote: I'm giving more more time time to do what
mentions.falsify_match: A revival of scale inside the four year window.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, though the laziness clause supplies a reason.

mentions.claim_text: He counts the years of the window out loud, running through 2025, 2026, 2027 and 2028.
mentions.quote: I see it it goes 2020 2025 2026 2027 and 2028
mentions.falsify_match: The window runs its full four years before the judgments arrive.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that healing is settled as foundation and that being moved by circumstances follows from being moved by the flesh rather than standing on the word.
mentions.quote: I'm not moved by by what what the circumstances say
mentions.condition_text: outcome tied to standing on the word
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching with a faith condition.

mentions.claim_text: He claims he called the red wave in November of the previous year, saw red spread over America, and says Chicago was the only reason Illinois did not go red for Trump.
mentions.quote: I saw it all that red come over America and I saw the Red Wave
mentions.falsify_match: A November 2023 statement in the corpus predicting a Republican sweep.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such prior statement is found.

mentions.claim_text: Asked what happens now to the economy, he says what he has seen is a great house of cards coming down, and that people should follow the Spirit for themselves rather than a cookie cutter answer.
mentions.quote: I saw a great house of cards coming down
mentions.falsify_match: A cascading financial collapse.
mentions.falsify_miss: No collapse, though he attaches no date here.

mentions.claim_text: He restates the four year window ending with the shmita cycle in 2028 and tells viewers abroad that it concerns the shmita cycle rather than the United States.
mentions.quote: we have a four-year window and the shimita cycle ends in 2028
mentions.falsify_match: The shmita cycle boundary falls where he places it and the window holds.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord tells him much prayer went up over the month of October and that he is granting more grace over what was going to be hell on earth, opening a small window whose length is unclear.
mentions.quote: much prayer that has went before me over the month of October
mentions.condition_text: the grace is credited to October intercession
mentions.time_phrase: a small little window, maybe to the first of the year
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: hell on earth is asserted as the averted branch, so nothing observable tests it.

mentions.claim_text: He says that back in May he saw the New York Yankees going to the World Series against the Los Angeles Dodgers, and saw attempted attacks on Yankee Stadium, with the Lord repeatedly telling him to watch the Yankees.
mentions.quote: I saw the vision of the New York Yankees going to the World Series
mentions.falsify_match: The 2024 World Series was Yankees against Dodgers, so the matchup half is checkable and lands; the attack half requires an attempt at Yankee Stadium.
mentions.falsify_miss: No attempted attack at the stadium.

mentions.claim_text: He says he had been told to watch the Yankees since May and prayed there would be no attacks at the World Series, knowing they were going but not whether they would win, and that he then saw Los Angeles.
mentions.quote: the Lord's been telling me to watch the Yankees club since May
mentions.condition_text: the attack half was prayed against
mentions.falsify_match: An attempted attack at the 2024 World Series.
mentions.falsify_miss: The series passed without incident, credited to prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord tells him well in advance who will win the Super Bowl, that he writes it down and keeps it private between himself, his wife and his children.
mentions.quote: he'll tell me way in advance who's going to win the Super Bowl
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable by design: the one cleanly scoreable prediction he makes is deliberately never published.

mentions.claim_text: He turns to answer viewers who say he told them the economy was going to crash, insisting he tries to be real rather than hyped.
mentions.quote: you said the economy is going to crash
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing of an answer to the objection.
